Dashboards in this hub

Each dashboard runs on its own, exactly as its own file does. Changes here are kept once you save the updated hub file.

This hub is your personal working file. It carries every dashboard in it, with the data built into each one, so don't email it. To share a dashboard, use that dashboard's own share or export button (tNPS: Download shareable copy), which carries your current numbers. Download original file gives back a dashboard file exactly as it was added, without your uploads, notes or settings.

Saved data on this computer

Uploads, coaching notes and settings live in this browser, not in the hub file, so they stay put if you move, rename or replace the file. Back up everything saves all of it, for every dashboard, in one file you can restore on this or another computer. It includes your coaching notes, so keep it for yourself.
